attributes.name: pydevtoolkit 1.0.0 — 16 CLI developer utilities
attributes.description:
Python Dev Toolkit (pydevtoolkit) 1.0.0 — 16 command-line developer utilities built exclusively on the Python standard library: no third-party dependencies, no network access, works anywhere Python 3.8+ runs. Every utility has an argparse CLI with -h/--help, file and stdin input, and exit codes 0 (success), 1 (runtime error), 2 (usage error).

Utilities: jsonfmt, csvstat, hashfile, b64, urlenc, difftxt, regexfind, timestamp, textstat, uniqcount, filesize, pickrand, passwdgen, hexdump, utfcheck, lorem.

Install: python3 -m pip install --no-build-isolation . (or sh install.sh for ~/.local/bin wrappers). Tests: python3 run_tests.py (92 tests). MIT licensed. Price: $15.00 (1500 cents).
